description: E02-7 (AC-06): the Field Station fs-org-a-1 of organization A flushes an SOS of TL-0010 it queued during A's custody, after the unit was checked in and handed over to B. The station clock runs 3 h fast: captured 2026-10-23 06:00 and sent 2026-10-24 05:00 station time, so the corrected capture is 2026-10-23 03:00 UTC for a receipt at 2026-10-24 02:00 UTC
